tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dkar zhi ba blo'i mun sel bzhugs so//

mañju gho ṣa ya na maḥ 'jam dkar zhi ba blo'i mun sel la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po sngon 'gro ni/ sāts+tsha gdab/ chu gtor btang*| lam 'phrang bsal/ yig brgya dang mtshan brjod 'don/ gzhan yang bsags sbyang la 'bad do// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po bsnyen pa ni/ gnas dben par lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas skyabs sems dang tshangs gnas bzhi sngon du btang nas/ las gshin gyi sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho ltar zla ba dkar ba'i mtha' ne'u gsing gis bskor ba'i glang chen thal dkar la sogs pas gang ba/ mtsho la me tog sna tshogs pa skyes pa'i steng du ngang pa sogs chu bya skad snyan sgrog pa du mas gang ba'i dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po yal ga dang lo 'dab gser las byas shing 'dab brgyad dkar po chu shel lta bu/ ge sar dmar ser/ lte ba ljang ser cung zad mtho ba'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba'i steng du rang gi sems nyid āḥdakar po 'od 'bar ba de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug gi nyes pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mkhyen rab phun sum tshogs pa ma lus pa bsdus āḥl thim de yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'jam pa'i dbyangs ston zla ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon skyabs sbyin gyis ut+pal dkar po re re'i yu ba 'dzin pa'i 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ g.yas kyi steng du shes rab kyi ral gri 'od 'bar ba dang g.yon pa'i steng du stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam 'chang ba/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i na tshod can mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa/

dbu skra thor tshugs zur phud lnga dang ldan pa'i rtse mor rin po che'i me tog dang*/ snyan gong du ut+pal dang dar dpyang 'phyang ba/ rin po che du ma'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub| se mo do/ ska rags/ do shal la sogs pa du mas mdzes shing*/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs mnabs shing zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ shin tu zhi zhing mdzes pa 'gying ba dang bcas pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar 'khyil ba la rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur par bsam/ oṃ mañju gho ṣa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar sbyar/ sha sha dha ra maṃ wa shū bh+raṃ khad+ga pustaṃ ka pa ṇiṃ pu ru ci ra ma ti shan+tiṃ pañca tsi raṃ ku mā raṃ pṛ thu ra ti wa ra mok+ṣaṃ pad+ma brtā ya tāk+ṣaṃ/ ku mā ri dhi da ha na dak+ṣaṃ mañju gho ṣa pra ṇa mya/ zhes bstod/ rang gi snying rtse mo gyen du phyogs pa'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa rtse mo shin tu rno ba'i lte bar a dkar po/ mdun nas brtsams te rtsibs drug la oṃ wākye daṃ na maḥ zhes pas g.yas su bskor ba/ gre phugs su a dkar po rnams gsal ba bdag gis sngags bzlas pas 'khor lo g.yas dang*/ sngags phreng g.yon bskor du drag la myur bar 'khor ba'i sngags phreng sa bon gre ba'i a rnams las 'od dkar 'phros pas sdig sgrib thams cad sangs sangs dag cing*/

'od zer phyir 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi mkhyen rab/ 'jig rten gyi lha dang drang srong nyi zla sman dang rig pa sogs kyi bcud thams cad bsdus rang nyid la thim pas rang nyid blo gros mtshungs pa med par gyur par bsam/ rtsa ba'i sngags de nyid 'bum phrag gcig bzla bar gsungs kyang grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag drug /dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba gcig /rtags kyi bsnyen pa/ rab 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mthong gsung thos pa/ 'bring po ti dang mtshon cha mthong ba/ tha ma rmi lam du me tog 'thu ba/ mar me sbar ba/ nyi zla shar ba/ dar phyar ba/ rol mo 'bud dkrol byas pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba/ rang lus las me 'bar ba/ chu las brgal ba/ gos dkar gyon pa sogs rmis pa'o// bsnyen pa gsum ni rtags kyi bsnyen pa gtso bor bzung ngo*// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal tsan+dan dkar po sogs dris byugs pa'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ ge sar dmar ser/ mu khyud mthing ga /lte ba ljang ser gyi dbus su mañji'i khar 'jam dkar gyi sku dang mtshan brjod bzhugs pa'i mthar mchod pas bskor/ dkar gtor gcig bshams/ rang tha mal pa'i thugs kyi mdun gyi lha sku sogs bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ dbang lha rnams mdun bskyed kyi lhar bstim zhing mchod bstod sngar ltar bya/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag la shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed du gsol/ zhes mos gus dang bcas pas sngags 'bum phrag drug bzla/ thun mtshams rnams su mchod cing maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa bshams la// 'dzam bu gling dang gling gzhan rnams// nor bu rin chen gyis brgyan te| |stong gsum rin chen ma lus pa// zhum pa med pa'i sems kyis dbul// zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal dbul/

mtshan brjod 'don/ gtor ma/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar gyur par bsam pas/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañju shrī ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis dbul/ sngar ltar mchod bstod tshul de 'dra bas sngar gyi rtags rnams gang rung ma mthong gi bar dang khyad par lha sku zhal 'dzum pa sogs ma byung bar du sgrub pa'o// gsum pa las sbyor ni/ sran dkar smin cing ma rul ba/ mes ma tshig cing snum gyis ma gos pa/ ba dmar po'am ra dkar mo'i 'o mar zhag bdun sbangs pa mar dkar gyis dril la/ nyi zla gzas thog mar bzung nas ma grol gyi bar lce 'og tu bcug la bdag mdun gnyis ka'i sngags ltar lhar gsal bas mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzlas pa byas pas myu gu 'byung la/ de nyid gzhan gyis ma reg par ba dmar ram ra dkar gyi 'o mas phul la sos ma reg par gyur mid byas pas shes rab phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la/ myu gu ma byung yang gdon gyis zin pa'i spyi bor btags pas gdon las grol ba sogs srung ba'i mchog tu gsungs so// gsum pa rjes la/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba/ mtshan brjod bklag thabs/ yon tan sgrub pa/ chos bshad pa/ phyir rgol dang rtsod pa/ legs bshad rtsom pa/ rten 'brel snying pos chom rkun 'ching ba/ ā dis dbang du bya ba/ kā dis tshe sring ba/ re'u mig zhe dgus rig sngags zlog pa/ ngag bkrol ba/ ral gri sgrub pa/ mig sman te bcu gsum las/ dang po slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ sngar sgrub pa'i dus kyi dkyil 'khor ltar bcas la bdag mdun so sor bskyed/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul bzlas pa byas nas| las bum du las gshin bskyed/ bzlas pa byas nas slob ma khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ kun mkhyen ye shes kyis gsol ba btab/ dkon mchog gsum sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ sku'i rjes gnang la slob mas// gang tshe blta bar 'dod pa'am// cung zad dri bar 'dod na yang*// mgon po 'jam dbyangs de nyid ni// gegs med par yang mthong bar shog

/ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma 'jam dbyangs mngon rtogs ltar gsal btab/ de'i spyi bor 'jam dbyangs kyi sku bzhag la/ slob ma'i spyi bor 'jam dpal dngos su byon nas thim par bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yin te// sangs rgyas sku yis byin brlabs pas// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku thob shog /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ de ltar sku'i rjes gnang gis gnas skabs su lus la nad med pa dang*/ gang gis mthong na dad pa skye ba/ mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi sku thob par 'gyur ro// gsung gi rjes gnang la slob mas/ brtse ldan khyod kyi mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer gyis// bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa rab bsal nas// bka' dang bstan bcos gzhung lugs rtogs pa yi// blo gros spobs pa'i snang ba stsal du gsol| gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dpon slob gnyis ka lhar gsal ba'i slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer spros pa zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i khar zhugs pa snying khar 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte ba aḥs mtshan pa'i rtsibs drug la 'khod par bsam/ yi ge drug pa rdo rje'i sgra// 'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba// sangs rgyas gsung gis byin brlabs pas// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung thob shog /ces dang*/ phreng ba gtad la sngags kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug /des gnas skabs su/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa la mkhas shing*/ mthar thug gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu thob par 'gyur ro// thugs kyi rjes gnang la slob mas/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*// snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa// mya ngan 'da' zhing 'khor mi gnas// 'jam dbyangs thugs la gsol ba 'debs// zhes lan gsum gsol/ dpon slob gnyis kas lus bsam gtan gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pas/ nam mkha'i dbyings su a dkar po gcig bsam la/

a nyer gcig ngag tu brjod pas nam mkha'i a de me long la ha btab pa bzhin tu yal nas dmigs med la dar cig bzhag /slar slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub a las byung*// a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa ste// tshig tu brjod spang rgyu yi mchog /'jam dbyangs thugs mchog rtogs par shog /a a aḥ zhes brjod/ des gnas skabs su chos la blo 'gro zhing*/ mthar thug shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ni slob mas/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// ji srid byang chub ma thob bar// bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis ni// bdag gi bla ma mdzad du gsol// gsum dang*/ mtshan brjod po ti slob ma'i gnas gsum dang lag tu gtad la/ brtson chen sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste// rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /rdo rje'i gdan ni ma lus ldan// 'jam dpal yon tan dbang thob shog /oṃ wā gī shwa ri ma hā gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes brjod/ des gnas skabs su rig pa'i gnas bcu la mkhas shing mthar thug 'jam pa'i dbyangs la mnga' ba'i yon tan ma lus pa thob par 'gyur ro// phrin las kyi rjes gnang la slob mas// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthar gtugs pa'i// sems can don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir// ji ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa// bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /gsum gsol/ rdo rje ral gri slob ma'i lag tu gtad la// rdo rje rnon po ral gri che// mtshon cha chen po rdo rje chos// rdo rje ral gris ma lus gcod// sangs rgyas phrin las kun rdzogs shog /oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣa ṇe duḥkhats+tshe da a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes brjod/ des gnas skabs su phrin las bzhi dang grub pa brgyad 'grub cing mthar thug 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang phrin las thams cad mnyam par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ de nas slob mas/

'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi// dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa// de yis skye bo thams cad kyis// bde gshegs shes rab thob par shog /ces smon lam btab/ dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ mchod bstod/ bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu bya'o| |gnyis pa mtshan brjod bklag thabs ni/ bdag mdun sngar ltar bskyed/ mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar bya/ bdag mdun gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su yi ge dhīḥlas/ de nas dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// zhes pa nas/ bdag cag yi rang ngo*// zhes pa'i bar gyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros pa mdun bskyed la phog /de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros thugs ka'i yig 'bru thams cad la phog pas yig 'bru rnams mtshan brjod kyi sgra dir dir sgrog cing yig 'bru rnams las 'od zer sgra dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ snod bcud snang grags thams cad yi ge'i gzugs dang de dag gis kyang tshig sgrog par bsam la mtshan brjod tshar gcig 'don/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ snod bcud thams cad dang rang nyid kyang 'od du zhu mdun bskyed la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu nas mi dmigs par bsam la/ dmigs med kyi ngang nas mtshan brjod tshar ci mang 'don/ tshul de lta bu rab rgyun chags/ 'bring thun drug /tha ma yang dus bzang la ma chags par byas pas bsod nams blo'i yul las 'das pa 'thob bo// gsum pa yon tan bsgrub pa ni/ rang 'jam dkar du gsal ba'i lce steng du a dkar po bsam/ de las 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mdun du spyan drangs/ slar a las 'od 'phros rgyal ba de rnams kyi thugs ka nas shes rab kyi ngo bo a dkar po grangs med pa spyan drangs/ rang gi lce steng gi a la thim pas rang lus thams cad a dkar pos mer gyis gang bar bsam la/ bzlas pa nus tshad byas pas mi brjed pa'i gzungs 'thob par 'gyur ro// bzhi pa chos 'chad pa ni/

rang nyid 'jam dkar du gsal ba'i mgrin par chos dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba'i nang thams cad drang nges kyi gsung rab ma lus pa'i ngo bo ā di kā di dkar pos gang bar bsam la sngags brgya phrag bzla/ chos 'chad pa'i tshe mgrin pa'i chos dung gi yi ge rnams na ra ra kha nas thon pa'i tshe gsungs dbyangs yan lag drug cu dam pa'i chos kyi seng ge'i sgras 'khor 'das thams cad tshims shing smin grol la bkod par bsam la chos bshad pas spobs pa mchog dang ldan par 'gyur ro// lnga pa phyir rgol dang rtsod pa'i tshe/ rang 'jam dkar du gsal ba'i g.yas pa'i mthe bong ral gri sngo sangs yu ba la a dkar pos mtshan pa rtse mo la me 'bar ba/ a de las 'od 'phros phyir rgol de yi snying khar shes rab kyi ngo bo a dkar po gnas pa de la phog pas rdo khab len gyis lcags blang ba ltar tshur blangs ral gri'i so la thim/ de rang gi snying khar thim pas kho bo'i shes rab kyang rang gi grogs su gyur/ ral gri'i rtse mo'i me mched pa phyir rgol gyi lce la phog pas lce thul gyis tshig par bsam la brtsad pas rang nyid mi rgyal mi srid do// drug pa legs bshad rtsom pa'i tshe/ rang nyid 'jam dkar du gsal ba'i thugs kar dpal be'u mig 'bug phrag yod pa'i mig thams cad dbyangs gsal gyi yi ges gang ba/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang bcas pa'i shes rab kyi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsam la sngags ci 'grub bzlas rjes/ sha sha dha ras bstod nas legs bshad brtsams pas blo gros thogs pa med par 'gyur ro// bdun pa rten 'brel snying pos chom rkun 'ching ba ni/ ras sam bal dkar po'i srad bu 'dom gang ba la mdud pa bcu bzhi byas pa/ rang 'jam dkar du gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su yi ge dhīḥl rten 'brel snying pos bskor bar bsam la/ rten 'brel snying po 'bum phrag bzlas nas srad bu la btab/ sus kyang ma mthong bar bya/

nam zhig las la sbyor tshe rgya shog la dug khrag gis liṅga'i khong par ming rus bris/ ming rus ma shes na yul che ge mo'i chom rkun jag pa khug cig chings sogs bri/ ru pa'i mthar ma rig pa'i smag rum du phob cig /rten 'brel bcu gnyis dmod pa sbyar bas bskor/ 'gugs 'dren bya/ ru pa stobs la gong gi srad bus bcings la/ jag pa rnams rten 'brel snying po'i gur du bcings par bsam la rang lus la bcang*/ 'jigs pa las grol nas srad bu sngar bzhin mis ma mthong bar sba/ ru pa dri bzang gi chus bkrus la rjes mi mngon par bya'o// brgyad pa ā dis dbang du bya ba ni/ rang 'jam dkar du gsal ba'i spyi bor a ā/ mig gnyis la i ī/ sna la u ū/ lce la ṛ ṝ/ rna ba gnyis la li lī/ snying la e ai/ lag pa gnyis la o au/ rdo rje'i rtse mor aṃ/ 'og sgor āḥrnams gsal ba dbyangs yig rnams khri phrag gsum bzla/ de thems nas dbang du bsdu ba de mdun du dmigs nas rang gi gnas so so'i yig 'bru rnams la rang 'dra'i yig 'bru dmar po lcags kyu lta bu spros/ kho'i gnas so so nas bzung kho'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor bkrag mdangs stobs nus rdzu 'phrul lus ngag yid gsum rang dbang med par bkug nas rang la thim pas rang nyid phun sum tshogs pa dar zhing rgyas/ kho rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus par bsams nas ā di'i mthar che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru ye aṅku sha dzaḥhriṃ hriṃ/ zhes stong phrag yan chad bzla/ tshul de ltar zla ba nya la bab pa'i tshe yang yang byas pas dbang du 'du bar nges so// dbang du gyur nas 'dod don grub ma thag gnas su bskyal te chos kyis phan gdags par bya'o// dgu pa kā dis tshe bsring ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa'i dbus su pad+ma dpe ris ltar re kha dkar po bris pa'i lte bar| bum pa'i nang du ba dang 'bri'i 'o mar lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas btab pa rgyun 'bab kyi chus bkang ba/

kha rgyan 'bras bu can dang ras dkar po'i bum dkris bya/ mchod gtor bshams/ rang 'jam dkar sgom zhing bum pa'i nang du sngar gyi mdun bskyed ltar 'jam dkar gsal btab la mchod bstod kyi bar byas rjes/ bum pa'i lha'i thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su dhīḥyig gi mthar kā dis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi tshe bcud bsdus pa bum pa'i lha la bstims/ de'i thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bab bum pa gang zhing lud pa rang gi spyi bor bab/ lus thams cad gang*/ 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin thob par bsam la kā di khri phrag gsum yan ci 'grub bzla/ thun bar du mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul/ mthar lha 'od du zhu ba bum chu dang dbyer med du bsam la bum chu btung zhing khrus byas pas tshe'i bar chad thams cad nges par zhi bar 'gyur ro// rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang 'dra'o// bcu pa re'u mig zhe dgus rig sngags bzlog pa ni/ mthing shog mtho gang pa la gser gyi dpe ris ltar bris la gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du bzhag /rang 'jam dkar du gsal bas re'u mig de dag re re gzhal yas khang re rer gyur pa'i dbus su yig 'bru re re bzhin 'jam dkar re rer gyur par bsam/ ye shes pa spyan drangs bstim/ dbang lhas dbang bskur/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa sogs sngar ltar byas la/ oṃ āḥsarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na murti wā gī shwa ra/ ma hā pa tsa sarba dharma/ ga ga na a ma la su pa ri shud+dha| dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na garbaha āḥ zhes khri phrag gcig bzlas/ mthar rten 'brel snying po brgya rtsas rab tu gnas la lha tshogs 'od du zhu nas yig 'brur gyur par bsam/ dar sna tshogs pas dril te sngags pa dam nyams kyis ma reg par byas nas rang lus la bcangs pas/ pha rol gyi mi dang mi min gyi rbod gtong thams cad kyis mi tshugs shing phar la 'joms pa'i nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// bcu gcig pa ngag bkrol ba ni/

grib dang byad phur sogs kyi gnod pas rang gi ngag la dig lkug smra mi bde ba sogs byung na/ rang 'jam dkar gsal ba'i lce'i steng du nyes pa'i ngo bo kaṃ nag po/ mgrin pa'i nang du ye shes kyi ngo bo yi ge raṃ dmar po/ snying khar 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar yaṃ sngo skya gsal ba'i 'khor lo g.yas dang yaṃ g.yon du 'khor ba'i yaṃ las rlung g.yos mgrin pa'i raṃ la phog pas ye shes kyi me 'bar te/ lce steng kyi kaṃ thul gyis bsregs nas ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad las grol zhing dag /kaṃ yig gi shul der yi ge a dkar po zhig bsam la ngag tu bzla/ ngag gis mi nus na yid kyis bzla/ de ltar yang yang byas pas ngag gi nyes pa thams cad las grol nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs sam mi'am ci'i bu mo'i mgrin pa ltar 'gyur ro// bcu gnyis pa ral gri bsgrub pa ni/ rgyal gyi nyin par gri lcags la ral gri sor bcu gnyis pa byas te/ lag pas bzung nas bzlas pa byas na ral gri'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro// bcu gsum pa mig sman ni/ bcud len gyi ril bu rdza gsar par blugs te lag pa g.yon tu bzhag nas g.yas pas bkab cing snga ma bzhin du bzlas pas 'od dang du ba dang rlangs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro// mig la byug pa dang khong du mid pas lkog gyur mthong ba dang*/ rga nad las grol ba dang*/ tshe'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro// de ltar las phran gang bsgrubs kyang slob dpon nus ldan la 'jam dkar gyi rjes su gnang ba thob nas dam tshig ma nyams par sngar bshad pa'i bsnyen sgrub gnyis grangs dus rtags gsum skyon med du thems pa zhig bsgrub na nges par 'grub pa gdon mi za'o// zhes pa'ang 'jam dkar gyi sgrub thabs slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī dang*/ lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba dang*/ de dag gsal byed bka' gter rnams su 'byung ba rnams nas legs par btus pa ma gtogs rang bzo spu tsam med pa/

'bri gung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pas rang gzhan la phan pa'i blo dang*/ mnga' ris stod kyi spong ba pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis lhag pa'i lhar bgyi pa'i slad du bskul ba la brten nas/ sa khams stag gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes lnga la/ 'bri chos phyug gi klung pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig lcang lo can gsang sngags kyi gan mdzod chen por bris pa'o// //shu bhaṃ//
